# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers of {colony}, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]ROOM TO LET[/bold], two blocks from the processor. It hums all night, and the rent is priced to match. Ask at the laundry. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], bunk space for a new contract hand off the next transport. Clean, quiet, works days. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]MAINTENANCE HANDS WANTED[/bold] for the night crew. Must not mind heights, noise or the cold. - [bold]CARGO LOADER OPERATOR[/bold], certified, sought for landing pad shifts. Steady hands and a clean safety record. - [bold]RETIRED COMPANY MEDIC[/bold] offers stitches, splints and honest advice after hours. Pay what you can.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]PRESSURE SUIT[/bold], one owner, seals bench tested, helmet scratched. Trade for a working radio. - [bold]PLAYING CARDS[/bold], real paper, one deck. Missing the four of clubs, which the seller blames on a cheat.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: ginger cat, answers to nothing, last seen near the mess hall. Reward of real coffee. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a wedding ring outside the clinic. Describe the inscription at the press office to collect it.
## Notices - Contract workers: read the small print before you sign an extension. The Herald will go through it with anyone who asks.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
